tasks.short: Record milling and planing production output

steps.what: Identify the production job and capture observed output counts with units
Record captured production output and calculate defined job totals
Reconcile production totals and correct count or job-assignment discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure one output-entry form and native job totals in {OPS_SYSTEM}, replacing recopying into a second production log. The operator still identifies the job, counts output and reconciles discrepancies; no sensor connection or automatic quality acceptance is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Output observations may be transcribed and totaled more than once.
tasks.enabler_now: Production records systems accept manual quantities as well as machine feeds.
tasks.still_hard: Associate the correct count, unit and job, especially after resets or mixed batches.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a plausible total attached to the wrong job.
tasks.altitude: Own accurate job output records with less duplicate transcription.

evidence.claim: MPDV HYDRA X records production quantities and machine states from controls or manual entry; no measured labour saving for this operator is established.
The single-entry configuration and assumed duplicate-transcription saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: The operator produces job ID, machine ID, batch or shift, observation time, total output count, unit and source count reference in s1; its 40 hours includes counting, identification and all capture.
Output means the defined counted quantity; accepted or rejected quality status requires the existing inspection process and is not inferred from the count.
Missing job identity, counter reset or uncertain units stop automatic totaling for the affected entry and return to manual reconciliation in s3.
Use native production-record configuration before custom integration; existing automatic recording earns no new labour saving.
Seven additional focal hours and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover entry rules, unit changes and access support.
Employee consultation and access checks are included in rollout where applicable; this design does not rank individual operators.
Machine operation and product inspection remain outside this recordkeeping boundary with no claimed saving.
research_questions: Does one captured output entry replace enough repeated transcription to outweigh checks and upkeep?

already_counted.description: Physical counting, job identification and entry capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65; gross 35 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 28%. Range 0-20% allows uncertain duplicate-entry share and count corrections; already automatic or single-entry records save zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own accurate job-linked output information while continuing physical production work.
reach: Help production supervisors resolve quantity discrepancies
role.ambitious_version: A milling or planing operator who captures output once and resolves meaningful discrepancies while retaining full machine-operation and inspection responsibilities.

job.title: Milling and Planing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
